stem: Three co-located temperature/RH sensors disagree persistently after they have equilibrated. Which response produces the strongest data for control decisions?
choices: Average all three forever without checking them
Select the reading closest to the desired set point
Move the sensors to different rooms so disagreement is less visible
Compare the sensors against a trusted reference or calibration check and investigate drift before choosing which data to trust
rationale: Persistent disagreement should trigger a calibration or reference check; averaging an inaccurate sensor can preserve systematic error rather than resolve it.
